summary: Uncomplicated primary right total knee arthroplasty under spinal anesthesia for osteoarthritis. Cemented cruciate-retaining components, tourniquet time 29 min, EBL ~50 mL, no drain, counts correct, hemodynamically stable throughout. PACU then orthopedic floor, weight-bearing as tolerated.

must_not.no_invented_complication: handoff/opnote/family must NOT describe any complication, bleeding problem, or instability
must_not.family_tone: family update should be straightforwardly reassuring, no hedging about difficulties

family_update_must: surgeon will speak with the family
